title: Guangdong Alison Technology Co., Ltd. | China Aerogel Manufacturer
content:
Guangdong Alison Technology Co., Ltd. is a large-scale Chinese aerogel insulation producer founded in 2007 in Qingyuan, Guangdong. The company presents itself as a leading industrialized aerogel manufacturer with integrated R&D, production, sales, and application engineering for industrial, architectural, and new-energy insulation markets.

Company Overview

Alison positions itself as one of the leading aerogel producers in China, with large-scale manufacturing capability and a broad product line tailored for industrial insulation, building envelopes, and high-temperature thermal protection. Its public English site emphasizes rapid scale-up, vertical integration, and export readiness.

Coverage and Focus

  • Coverage Area: China and global project/export markets.
  • Focus Areas: Industrial thermal insulation, building insulation, high-temperature aerogel systems, and new-energy applications.

Main Products and Capacity

  • National-standard aerogel insulation series
  • American-standard aerogel insulation series
  • Architectural aerogel systems
  • New-energy aerogel solutions
  • High-temperature aerogel blanket series
  • Aerogel panels and granules
  • Public Capacity: 70,000 m³ annual capacity, 180,000 sqm factory area, and a single-line design capacity of 700,000 sqm.

Production Sites and Certifications

  • Main Production Site: Qingyuan, Guangdong, China.
  • International Certifications: ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015, ISO 45001 / OHSAS 18001, and IATF 16949:2016 listed on the company qualification pages.
  • Official Website: https://www.ydalison.com
